Thanks for the heads up, Marissa — and Jamie, no worries, feel better soon.

Options I’m proposing (we need to be able to give feedback on today's loop if possible):
1) Panel proceeds for 30 minutes and we capture the session recording + Markus and I mark primary areas; then ask Jamie to send the recorded prompt walkthrough within 2 hours for the remaining exercise.
2) Convert today’s session to an asynchronous exercise: we send instructions now, Jamie records a 15–20min walkthrough and code artifacts, and we review offline.
3) Reschedule to next available slot (I have limited availability today after 2pm PT).

If everyone is OK with option 1 or 2, Marissa — can you share the short recording guidance & ask Jamie to upload to the Drive link below? If option 1, Markus and I will join the Zoom at 10:30 and start; Laura, can you still make the shortened slot?
